purpose: Construct an ordered declarative representation of two cited Practice metric candidates without defining or calculating a metric.

required.statement: Validate the exact feature identity, two required keyed opaque inputs, ordered object population, and canonical provenance.
Preserve objects 021 and 034, input and output identities, opaque payloads and externally supplied results, reservations, and traceability.
Provide deterministic structural construction, validation, canonical serialization, deserialization, comparison, and trace inspection.

forbidden.statement: Do not define or compute a metric formula, scale, unit, threshold, observation window, cognitive-load value, or scientific score.
Do not invent types, dimensions, numerical validation, temporal semantics, progression, effects, or partial successful results.

deferred.statement: Scientific metric evaluation requires an external evaluator and scientific execution requires an external executor.

operations.purpose: Return the immutable ordered metric-candidate representation.

constraints.statement: Both values are independently required under candidate status and remain opaque.

fields.name: externally_supplied_results
fields.semantic_role: opaque results preserved without numeric validation

preconditions.statement: Inputs 007-1 and 007-2 and objects 021 and 034 are present in canonical documentary order.
Every input is supplied under candidate status with canonical contract, IR, test-plan, and source references.

postconditions.statement: Both metric objects and every opaque value remain ordered, unchanged, and traceable.
No metric formula, exact value, scale, unit, threshold, or observation window is asserted.

invariants.statement: Externally supplied opaque results may be preserved but are never numerically validated by this package.
No absent type, unit, threshold, duration, method, progression, or effect is introduced.

steps: validate exact identities cardinality and provenance
preserve opaque values and documentary order

partial_order.before: validate exact identities cardinality and provenance
preserve opaque values and documentary order

prescription_basis: Validation, exact order, preservation, deterministic structure, and atomic publication are observable; metric computation and internal sequencing are not prescribed.

error_contract.condition: Source error id invalid_feature_identity: the feature id is not TLC-FC-13-PRACTICE-007.
Source error id missing_required_input: input 007-1 or 007-2 is absent.
Source error id invalid_input_type: a required input is not opaque.
Source error id missing_source_reference: a covered object lacks its canonical reference.
Source error id provenance_mismatch: identity, order, or provenance differs from the canonical population.
Source error id structural_error: the declarative representation violates this contract.
Source error id external_evaluator_required: metric evaluation is requested without an external evaluator.
Source error id external_executor_required: scientific execution is requested without an external executor.
Source error id implementation_out_of_scope: an undeclared metric formula, validation, scale, threshold, progression, or effect is requested.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the ordered declarative metric representation and stable errors.
Do not calculate or validate an exact metric value.
Internal architecture remains free when observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: Both metric identities, candidate status, opacity, and documentary order remain exact.
Structural validity never authorizes a formula, scale, threshold, or exact metric result.

dependencies.purpose: Stable object, input, and output identities

notes: Conformance is structural and asserts no exact metric value.
